fix: Remote actions from the phone (Block 24d): chat message to all players (say), kick a listed player and restart a server. Off by default; needs the gateway switch, the user's own remoteActions switch, server.manage (admin/operator) and a session opened with the second factor. Step-up: a fresh TOTP code (never a recovery code) opens a 5-minute window per session for say and kick; a restart always needs its own code. Limits: 10 actions per session in 5 minutes, one restart per server in 2 minutes (a failed restart does not count). Say text: printable ASCII, 1-150 characters, no quotes, semicolons, percent signs or slashes, sent as its own packet outside the console allowlist. Kick uses the verified slot+name kick from 4.18.14. Also over the public Caddy domain (TOTP login for every role there), marked in the audit. Audit remote.action.<kind> with user, client and result; kick and restart also raise an alert when alerts are on. No start/stop, no free RCON, no config or vault access from the phone.
notes: 4.18.19 source preflight with the Remote Actions gate (scripts/verify-4.18.19-actions-gate.mjs). Gateway tested with a fake second factor and fake actions; backend tested end to end with a real TOTP setup and a stubbed RCON-less instance. A real say/kick/restart on a running CoD4x server from a phone is open. Development source, not a release.
architecture: Shared Runtime with Windows and Linux adapters; schema-based Config Engine; per-instance RCON, master status, master list verification, plugin manager and B3 runtime; per-instance network exposure; eBc-B3 dependency layer
